name: Mozambique
snapshot: Frelimo, in power since independence in 1975, kept the presidency after a disputed 2024 election and months of deadly protests, while an insurgency simmers in the gas-rich north.
culture: Mozambique's long coastline was part of the Swahili world before Portugal colonised it, and Island of Mozambique, the old colonial capital, is UNESCO-listed. Marrabenta music came out of Maputo's suburbs, and the timbila xylophone orchestras of the Chopi people are on UNESCO's heritage list. Mia Couto is among Africa's most celebrated novelists.
society: A civil war from 1977 to 1992 killed around a million people. Huge offshore gas finds in Cabo Delgado drew TotalEnergies and ExxonMobil, but an Islamic State-linked insurgency since 2017 has displaced over a million people. A "hidden debts" scandal in 2016 tipped the country into crisis. Most people are poor farmers.
situation: Daniel Chapo of Frelimo was declared winner of the October 2024 election; challenger Venâncio Mondlane called it fraud and led months of protests in which hundreds were killed, the worst unrest since the civil war. Chapo took office in January 2025 and later signed a political accord with opposition parties. In January 2026 TotalEnergies restarted its $20 billion LNG project in Cabo Delgado, frozen since insurgents overran the nearby town of Palma in 2021, a bet that Rwandan-backed security operations have contained the Islamic State-linked insurgency. Mondlane goes on trial at the Supreme Court on 17 November 2026 on five charges, including incitement to terrorism.
power: A presidential republic. The president is directly elected for five years, at most two terms, and appoints the prime minister; Frelimo has controlled the presidency and parliament since independence.

story: Portuguese traders arrived in 1498, but full colonial control came only in the 20th century. FRELIMO fought a ten-year war for independence, won in 1975, and set up a one-party Marxist state. A civil war against RENAMO, backed by Rhodesia and South Africa, killed about a million people before peace in 1992. FRELIMO has won every election since. An Islamist insurgency in Cabo Delgado began in 2017, near huge gas fields.
